Card System

ARTWORK AUTOMATION.

Drop finished artwork into the inbox, run the installer workflow, and the site replaces reader field cards with installed artwork while keeping the dossier/evidence system intact.

Open Art BatchesNext 10 QueueMachine-readable dataMachine-readable dataBatch Prompt Export

Automation Loop

01

Generate

Open the batch plan and generate the next group of card images using the prepared prompts.

02

Drop Into Inbox

Add each finished image as a pending item with deckId, cardId, label and sourceUrl or sourceDataUri.

03

Install

The installer writes the image asset, replaces the expected SVG card wrapper, and updates the install log.

04

Rebuild

The normal build checks downloads, dossiers, artwork routes, public copy, intake health and card-deck system health.

Inbox Item Format

{
  "deckId": "people-of-interest",
  "cardId": "george-soros",
  "label": "George Soros",
  "sourceUrl": "https://example.com/card.webp",
  "status": "pending"
}

Use sourceDataUri instead of sourceUrl when the image is embedded as a data URL.

Boundary

Artwork is presentation only. Evidence, current intelligence, scores, source routes and corrections stay in the card dossier and source ledger.

Artwork pipeline: batch plan → queue → inbox → installer → manifest → dossier.
